_note: Full-domain Benchmark I verification of the 62-qubit circuit archived in artifacts/checkpoints/submission_24_59.zip (sha256 af469847…), run on 2026-11-05 with the official verifier from this repository. Unlike invsqrt_kernel_receipt.json (a published Kaggle kernel run), this is a local run: 3,133,452 inputs x 64 shots = 200,540,928 shots, the graded budget. Seeds derive from the circuit sha256, so the run is re-derivable from the command recorded below. `sample_vs_full_domain_delta` is an absolute score delta (full domain minus the 25,600-shot sample of the same circuit), not a ratio.

protocol.shots_per_x_note: 64 is the verifier default and the graded budget; max_x is the default 3*(2^10-2)^2.

run.interpreter: CPython 3.13 (.venv-kickmix) with the bundled kickmix extension
run.sandbox: standard verifier batch size 256, batches-per-chunk 64, max_workers = all cores
